@deskUpdAvailable.description: Sidebar notice, first line: a newer Epic Cash Desktop is out (the version is on the line under it).

@deskUpdNotice.description: Narrow sidebar: tooltip and screen-reader name of the update icon.

@deskUpdDownload.description: Button and tooltip: download the newer version inside the app (it is installed after a restart).

@deskUpdOpensPage.description: Tooltip of the update notice when the app cannot install the update itself: a click opens the download page in the browser.

@deskUpdDownloading.description: Sidebar notice and Settings › About while the update downloads. {percent} is a whole number from 0 to 100.

@deskUpdRestart.description: Button: close the app, install the downloaded update and open the app again.

@deskUpdReady.description: The update is downloaded and checked; it is installed by Restart to update.

deskUpdRestartHint: The app closes, installs it and opens again.

@deskUpdRestartHint.description: Settings › About, under '{version} is ready': what Restart to update does.

@deskUpdFailed.description: Sidebar notice and Settings › About: the download failed (the reason is in the tooltip or under it).

@deskUpdTryAgain.description: Second line of the notice and button: download the update again; it carries on from what already arrived.

@deskUpdInstallFailed.description: The downloaded update could not be started; the download page is offered instead.

@deskUpdOpenPage.description: Second line of the notice after a failed install: a click opens the download page in the browser.

deskUpdErrDamaged: The file did not match the signed update information.

@deskUpdErrDamaged.description: Why the download failed: wrong size or SHA-256. The file was deleted.

@deskUpdErrStopped.description: Why the download failed: the connection dropped. Trying again carries on from what arrived.

deskUpdErrInstall: The new version could not be put in place.

@deskUpdErrInstall.description: Why Restart to update failed: the installer could not be started or the app file could not be replaced.

@deskUpdUnfinished.description: Sidebar notice and Settings › About (Windows): an update was started but Setup did not finish (it was stopped or failed part way); the action runs the update again. The version is on the line under it.
